questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘impose’.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Release**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"impose"** means to force something (especially an unwelcome decision or ruling) on someone. (थोपना)

 
 
• **Example: **The government decided to **impose **a curfew to maintain law and order.
 
 
 
• **"Release"** refers to allowing someone or something to be free or to stop holding something. (रिहा करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The prisoner was **released **after serving his sentence.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'impose'** is **'release'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Compel **(विवश करना): To force or oblige someone to do something.

 
 
• **Example:** The urgent need for medical attention **compelled **him to call the doctor.
 
 
 
• **Ennoble **(उन्नत करना): To elevate in degree, excellence, or respect; to dignify.
 
 
• **Example: **The knight's bravery in battle **ennobled **his name in the realm.
 
 
 
• **Cure** (इलाज करना): To relieve a person or animal of the symptoms of a disease or condition.
 
 
• **Example:** Scientists are working endlessly to **cure **diseases that were once thought incurable.

questions.question: Reorganisation of states in the 1950s was done based on ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **linguistic lines**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The reorganization of states in the 1950s was based on **linguistic lines**, dividing regions according to predominant languages.
 
• This historical decision led to the creation of states where the majority of people spoke the same language.
 
• The state of Maharashtra was created primarily for Marathi speakers, and Karnataka for Kannada speakers.
 
• Belgavi was allocated to Karnataka, which has been a point of dispute with Maharashtra ever since.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1:** Reorganization based on religious lines was not the main criterion for state boundaries in the 1950s.
 
• **Option 2:** Caste was not considered a basis for the reorganization of states during that period.
 
• **Option 4:** Economic lines were also not the primary factor in the reorganization of states in the 1950s.

questions.question: When do children learn to regulate the release of the objects that they are gripping?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**6 - 12 months**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The development of fine motor skills encompasses various stages, including the ability to regulate the release of objects.
 
• During **the 6 to 12 months** age interval, babies transition from reflexive grasping to more intentional actions with their hands and fingers.
 
• This period is characterized by infants developing the capability to not only grab objects but also to release them deliberately, which is a crucial step in fine motor development.
 
• It signifies the beginning of more precise and controlled use of the fingers and hands, setting the foundation for more complex tasks like feeding themselves, drawing, and playing with smaller toys.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **3 - 6 months**: At this stage, infants are primarily developing their grasp reflex and might start to reach for and hold objects, but the regulation of release is not yet refined.
 
• **2 - 4 years**: This is a period where children have already developed the basic fine motor skills and are refining their abilities, such as drawing and cutting with scissors, which is beyond the skill of regulating object release.
 
• **12 - 24 months**: Children in this age group are enhancing their fine motor skills further, engaging in more complex activities than simply releasing objects, such as stacking blocks accurately or stringing beads.
